project_type: React SPA with Vite + TypeScript frontend and PostgreSQL/Supabase backend
build_system: npm with Vite bundler; tsc for type checking
test_framework: vitest with @testing-library/react, jsdom environment, test-setup.ts in src/
verification_instructions: 1. Run typecheck: cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit. 2. Run tests: cd frontend && npm run test -- --run. 3. Run build: cd frontend && npm run build. 4. Verify Docker build: docker build -t bom-frontend ./frontend
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode - npm registry accessible. Docker available (v5.2.3). Node.js 22.23.2. No eslint config file exists yet (only eslint in devDependencies). Supabase env vars (VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY) needed at build time.
contribution_requirements: Push to feat/db-baseline-v1.1.5 branch. Keep existing 320 tests passing.
key_patterns: Vite env vars use VITE_ prefix via import.meta.env. Path alias @/ mapped to src/. Strict TypeScript. supabase.ts gracefully handles missing env vars with console.warn and placeholder values.
directory_structure: Root: baseline/, migrations/, tests/, docs/, ci/, frontend/. Frontend: src/ with App.tsx, main.tsx, canvas/, components/, hooks/, lib/, pages/, stores/, types/. No .github/ directory exists yet. No Dockerfile, docker-compose, Makefile, or .env.example.
